# Paradise Matrix

> Paradise Matrix Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore company that builds and commercialises
> agentic AI for organisations that must account for what their systems do. It develops
> the RealRelay.ai platform and vertical AI agents, beginning with cybersecurity and
> education, and operates from Singapore across Asia and the Gulf. Its parent company is
> Edvance International Holdings Limited, a cybersecurity group listed on the Main Board
> of the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.

## What agentic AI means here

An AI agent perceives its context, plans a sequence of steps, uses tools and carries out
multi-step tasks with limited human intervention. A vertical is an agent, or a group of
them, carrying the data, tools and constraints of a single domain. All verticals run on
one shared platform core.

## RealRelay.ai

A platform for creating, governing and deploying AI agents without writing code.

- Policy, identity and audit sit in the execution path, not in a report afterwards. Prompt,
  plan, tool call, model selected, output and approver are recorded in sequence.
- Agents are assembled by describing them, so the people who understand a workflow build it.
- Requests are routed to a model chosen per task, weighing speed, cost, capability and
  sensitivity, across third-party and open-weight models.
- Security validation is carried inside the platform. An autonomous validation agent
  continuously tests the agents built on it, within a scope the customer authorises,
  reasons the way an attacker would to surface real exposures, and returns a risk rating
  with supporting evidence and remediation guidance, then re-tests after a fix.
- Deployment: managed cloud, customer infrastructure, or fully disconnected. On
  on-premises and air-gapped tiers, open-weight models run locally with no outbound
  telemetry. This does not apply to the multi-model cloud tier, which routes to
  third-party model providers.

## Domains

- Cybersecurity: alert triage, automated adversary simulation, threat
  monitoring and analysis, incident response support.
- Education: a learning environment where students across faculties build agents for the
  discipline they are studying, lecturers work in the same space rather than reviewing at
  submission, and classroom recordings and academic performance signals are turned into
  insight educators can act on. The institution retains what each cohort creates.
- Fintech: decision intelligence that takes apart investment cases and sales performance
  before capital is committed; anti-money-laundering and know-your-customer review;
  entity research mapping who sits behind a counterparty and the risk attached to them;
  and deployment inside an institution's own environment with customer-held keys.

## Markets

Singapore is the home and reference market: a domain ships there first and the rest of
the footprint is measured against it. Beyond Singapore: the ten ASEAN economies, Hong
Kong (the parent company's base and the route into North Asia), Japan and the United Arab
Emirates. What these markets share is the condition the platform was built for —
regulated industries, data that must stay in country, and institutions answerable for the
systems they run.

## Ecosystem

- RealRelay.ai — the platform. https://www.realrelay.ai
- CWG Innovations — engineering partner, Singapore. https://www.cwgsg.ai
- Edvance International Holdings — parent company of Paradise Matrix. A cybersecurity
  group headquartered in Hong Kong and listed on the Main Board of the Stock Exchange of
  Hong Kong. https://www.edvanceintl.com

## Stated limits

Paradise Matrix does not currently hold formal security certifications and does not
describe itself as certified for anything it has not earned. Security, sovereignty and
compliance characteristics vary by product, release stage and deployment tier, and are
governed by the customer agreement.
